items: A synthetic active-row provider can replay explicit listening, transcribing, recoverableError and terminal events while preserving concrete cancel/finish/retry request identities.

Keep fixture completion separate from actual sampling and service success. A stop action may enter a controlled processing fixture state, labeled fixture transition until underlying observer mapping is closed.
Use fixture owner/attempt generation to ignore cancelled or stale completion; label this guard as independent until official completion producer is proven.
